title: Two names, one list
caption: Assignment hands over a name, not a copy. After b = a there is still one list, and a change made through either name shows up under both. a[:] and list(a) are the two ways to ask for a second list, and then the names go their separate ways.

cells.label: b = a
cells.note: still one list; now it answers to b as well

cells.label: c = a[:]
cells.note: a second list, with the same contents. c == a, c is not a
